idea-plugin.name: fespalier
idea-plugin.description:
Shows what fespalier finds in your Flutter route tree (lib/app/) as inline errors and warnings, and runs fsp gen from the Tools menu.

  • Inline diagnostics. A file under the app folder (fespalier: app_dir: in pubspec.yaml, lib/app by default) or any other Dart file under lib/ (a string path that matches no route, since fespalier 0.7.0) is highlighted with the problems fsp check --json reports for it, with severity. Saving a file checks again.
  • Tools | fespalier: Generate runs fsp gen and writes lib/app.g.dart. Tools | fespalier: Check checks on demand and lists what it found.
  • Tasks (since fespalier 0.22.0). Each task of fespalier: tasks: in pubspec.yaml has a run icon in the gutter, and runs as a fespalier task run configuration (fsp dev, fsp build <target> or fsp run <name>). Tools | fespalier: Run Task... lists them all.
  • pubspec.yaml (since fespalier 0.23.0). The keys of the fespalier: section complete as you type, show what they do in the quick documentation, and an unknown key, a value of the wrong type or one off a list is highlighted. The rest of the file keeps the checks of the JSON Schema Store's pubspec schema.
  • Runner. Uses fsp from your PATH, or dart run fespalier when there is none. Settings | Tools | fespalier chooses, and sets the path to fsp.

It is a thin layer over the generator's --json output; nothing is re-implemented in the IDE. It works in IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio with the Dart plugin.

action.description: Run fsp gen: write the generated routes file
Run fsp check: report route-tree errors and warnings
